selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent rules were created, included in the rebuilt initramfs, retained after reboot, and successfully rejected a post-reboot load attempt.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the node reported RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID c2f29441-0515-4717-99f7-a7647824278d was captured, reboot scheduling was acknowledged, and the recovered node reported changed boot ID fbb1ee63-05d8-4411-9881-5e8629992d53, running system state, read-write root filesystem, retained configuration, and effective module blocking.
